title: Invertibility propagates from bounded-flat models to telescopes
statement: Let f : Z → Y be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism], with derived categories in a common universe [def-pc-derived-category], F the recorded derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback] supplied with a strong monoidal structure [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and additive termwise tensor pullback H [def-pc-module-pullback]. Write q for the homotopy quotient, Q_Y,Q_Z for the derived localizations, L=Q_Y⋙F, G=H^h⋙Q_Z. Let B be boundedFlatShiftRepresentative [def-sc-bounded-flat-shift-representative], T be flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative and let stage maps mean flatTelescopeStageMap [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map]. For a fixed e : F(𝟙_Y[1]) ≅ 𝟙_Z[1], set b_e(K)=F(c_Y(K)⁻¹);δ_F(𝟙_Y[1],K);(e⊗id);c_Z(FK), where c is the canonical translated-unit comparison [def-sc-scheme-canonical-shift-unit-iso]. Suppose a_X:LX→GX for X in T is natural for all homotopy morphisms between the representatives and satisfies a_{qP[1]};commShift_G(qP)=F(commShift_Q_Y(qP));b_e(Q_YqP);a_{qP}[1] for every literal flat telescope P. Suppose a_X is invertible whenever X also belongs to B. Then a_X is invertible for every X in T. This assertion takes the morphisms and their normalized shift square as input and does not construct them.

source.place: Sum and inverse-cone invertibility part of steps 1--3 of lem-sc-flat-telescope-bounded-normalization-extension; inherited agent expansion of the telescope model argument.

proof.text: Apply unshifted invertibility after destructing the representative. For its one-fold translate, use the normalized shift equation: its component composed with the target commShift is invertible. Cancel that invertible commShift component using IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right.

proof_origin.place: Separate construction of forward morphisms from invertibility in the inherited sum/cone plan.

theorem flat_telescope_normalization_isIso
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)]
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).Additive]
    (e : (derivedPullback f).obj ((𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≅
        (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Z))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (α : ∀ X : HomotopyCategory
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ),
        flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X →
          ((DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f).obj X ⟶
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
              (DerivedCategory.Qh : HomotopyCategory
                (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
                schemeDerivedCategory Z)).obj X))
    (hαnat : (∀ (X X' : HomotopyCategory
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
          (hX : flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X) (hX' : flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X')
          (s : X ⟶ X'),
          (DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f).map s ≫ (α X' hX') =
            (α X hX) ≫
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
                (DerivedCategory.Qh : HomotopyCategory
                  (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
                  schemeDerivedCategory Z)).map s))
    (hαshift :
        ∀ (P : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (htel : isFlatTelescope Y P),
        let X := (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P
        let G := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          (DerivedCategory.Qh : HomotopyCategory
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
            schemeDerivedCategory Z)
        (α (X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ⟨P, htel, Or.inr rfl⟩) ≫
            (G.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app X =
          (derivedPullback f).map ((DerivedCategory.Qh.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app X) ≫
            ((derivedPullback f).mapIso
                (schemeCanonicalShiftUnitIso Y (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj X)).symm ≪≫
              asIso (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (derivedPullback f)
                ((𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj X)) ≪≫
              tensorIso e (Iso.refl _) ≪≫
              schemeCanonicalShiftUnitIso Z
                ((derivedPullback f).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj X))).hom ≫
            (α X ⟨P, htel, Or.inl rfl⟩)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧')
    (hαbounded : ∀ (X : HomotopyCategory
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
      (hX : flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X),
      boundedFlatShiftRepresentative Y X → IsIso (α X hX)) :
    ∀ (X : HomotopyCategory
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
      (hX : flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X), IsIso (α X hX)
